linked_issues.body:
### Initial Checks

- [x] I confirm that I'm using Pydantic V2

### Description

This is a regression on `main` (`2.14.0a1`); I could not reproduce it on any released version (checked 2.13.4 and 2.10.6 under the same conditions). It affects Python 3.10–3.13 (verified on 3.10, 3.12 and 3.13); Python 3.14 is unaffected.

If `__annotations__` has ever been **read** on a metaclass appearing in a model's metatype MRO (e.g. `ModelMetaclass` itself, or `abc.ABCMeta`), then any generic model parametrized **for the first time afterwards** gets a broken schema:

- type variables are not substituted (`x: T` ends up with an `any` schema), and
- field defaults are dropped (fields with defaults become required).

Parametrizations built *before* the read keep working, since their schemas are already cached — which makes this very order-dependent and confusing to track down in a real test suite.

Reading an attribute sounds like an odd trigger, but it happens in the wild: on CPython ≤ 3.13, reading `__annotations__` on a (heap) class that has none **auto-creates a plain `__annotations__ = {}` entry in that class's `__dict__`** (see the [annotations HOWTO](https://docs.python.org/3/howto/annotations.html)). `langgraph` does such a read at import time (`get_cached_annotated_keys` in `langgraph/_internal/_fields.py` has a `getattr(base, "__annotations__", None)` fallback — added for Python 3.14 compat, ironically — which ends up planting `{}` on `abc.ABCMeta`). So a plain `import langgraph.preb [...]
linked_issues.title: Generic model parametrization drops field defaults and typevar substitution after `__annotations__` is read on a metaclass (Python <= 3.13)

packet.objective: Fix access of annotations in `safe_get_annotations()` in Python <= 3.13

ruling.rationale: The only later references are a downstream project (psygnal) hitting a behaviour change in 2.14.0a1 with annotation-free subclasses and working around it on their side. Whether pydantic treats that as a regression is not established, so on this evidence the case is neither clean nor seeded.
